title: Your own rule
topic: Set a limit with your bank data

steps.title: “No single bet gets more than 10%”
steps.body: A rule made on a calm day protects you on a loud one. Size it by your [[risk-capacity]]: money you need in the next few years stays out of bets.

steps.prompt: Why decide the rule before a hype starts?
options: Decisions made under hype and time pressure are often rushed
steps.explanation: “Only 3 seats left” and “everyone is buying” are built to rush you. A rule you set earlier gives you something to check against.

steps.prompt: Your rule is “max 10% in one bet”. That bet loses everything. What happens to your savings?
steps.explanation: The rule doesn't stop the loss. It limits how much one bad bet can take.
